features.description: Duplicate/branch primitive: POST /api/activities/{id}/duplicate copies an activity into the caller's library (new act- id, source_* provenance, visibility=draft, content deep-copied, unassigned). Source must be the caller's own OR published. + Duplicate affordance on own activity cards / 'New from an existing one'.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicating an own activity yields a new draft with source_activity_id + source_owner_uid set, unassigned, independently editable
Duplicating a non-owned, non-published id returns 404 (no existence leak)
A shared _copy_activity helper deep-copies content (skill/artefact/elements/materials) and resets id/owner/assignment/visibility
Frontend: Duplicate action on own cards refreshes the list with the new draft
features.notes: db.copy_activity shared helper (deep-copy, reset id/owner/provenance/visibility/timestamps) + POST /{id}/duplicate (own OR published source, else 404). Frontend: duplicateActivity() + Duplicate action prepends the draft. 4 backend + 1 frontend test.

features.description: Publish/unpublish endpoints: POST /api/activities/{id}/publish (->published) and /unpublish (->private). Owner OR researcher (shared guard with M3b). Validate the transition set; unpublish never touches already-adopted copies.
acceptance_criteria: publish sets visibility=published; unpublish sets visibility=private
Owner can publish/unpublish their own; non-owner non-researcher gets 404
Transition validation rejects nonsense states; unpublish leaves adopted copies untouched
Both endpoints OTel-span the action keyed by activity + owner
features.notes: POST /{id}/publish + /unpublish via shared _load_for_modify (owner OR researcher; researcher path OTel-spans auth.researcher_bypass). 4 tests. _load_for_modify is also the M3b guard for PATCH/DELETE.

features.description: Shared catalogue endpoint: GET /api/activities?published=true returns every teacher's published activities, enriched with ownerLabel (resolve_owner_labels) for by-owner grouping. Open to any teacher (published-only, read-only) - distinct from researcher scope=all.
acceptance_criteria: ?published=true returns published activities across all owners, each with ownerLabel
Any teacher can call it (not researcher-gated); it never returns draft/private
Distinct gate from scope=all; explicit per-mode tests, no silent fallback
features.notes: db.list_published_activities + GET ?published=true (any teacher, published-only, ownerLabel-enriched via shared _serialize_with_owner_labels). 3 tests; distinct gate from scope=all.

features.description: Adopt-by-copy: POST /api/activities/{id}/adopt copies a PUBLISHED activity into the caller's library (copy semantics from M2, source_* provenance, visibility=draft). Rejects adopting a non-published activity you don't own (404).
acceptance_criteria: Adopting a published activity creates a draft copy owned by the caller with source_* set
Adopting a non-published activity you don't own returns 404
Reuses the _copy_activity helper; the source teacher's edits never mutate the adopted copy
features.notes: POST /{id}/adopt — published-only source (else 404), reuses copy_activity -> draft copy w/ provenance. 3 tests. Backend full fast suite green.

features.description: Shared activities UI + publish toggle: a 'Shared activities' section on the activities library (grouped by owner, attribution shown) with a Use/adapt action -> adopt-copy -> lands in Your activities as a draft; a Publish/Unpublish control + visibility badge on own cards. Teacher-auth throughout.
acceptance_criteria: Shared activities section lists other teachers' published activities grouped by owner name
Use/adapt copies into the caller's library as a draft and surfaces it in Your activities
Publish/Unpublish toggle + visibility badge on own cards; unpublish removes from the catalogue
A teacher cannot edit or assign another teacher's activity directly (only adopt)
features.notes: Shared activities section (grouped by owner) + Use/adapt -> adopt-copy draft into Your activities; Publish/Unpublish toggle + visibility on own cards. teacherApi: publish/unpublish/adopt/listSharedCatalogue. 41 FE tests (page.test.tsx) green; committed e703878.

features.description: Researcher CRUD-over-all moderation: extend the shipped researcher read-bypass to write/delete/publish/unpublish on the activities collection only. role:researcher may modify any teacher's activity; User.is_researcher guard + auth.researcher_bypass OTel span. Scoped to activities, not a general write-bypass.
acceptance_criteria: A researcher can PATCH/DELETE/publish/unpublish another teacher's activity (200)
A non-researcher non-owner still gets 404 on the same operations
The bypass is scoped to the activities collection and OTel-spanned like the read path
features.notes: GET/PATCH/DELETE authorize via _load_for_modify (owner OR researcher); ownership preserved on a researcher edit; auth.researcher_bypass OTel span. Removed the now-dead _load_owned. TestResearcherCrud x3. Committed 2b9f9d8.

features.description: Light History panel: replace the History tab roadmap stub with a read-only provenance + lifecycle view -- 'Adapted from {sourceOwnerLabel} activity' (when source_* set), current visibility, created/updated timestamps. Backend surfaces sourceOwnerLabel on the activity GET. NOT version-timeline+rollback (Year-2).
acceptance_criteria: An adopted activity History shows its provenance (adapted-from + owner) + lifecycle
A from-scratch activity shows created/updated + visibility with no provenance line
Backend enriches the activity GET with sourceOwnerLabel (resolve_owner_labels); read-only
features.notes: Backend: GET /{id} enriches sourceOwnerLabel (resolve_owner_labels). Frontend: History tab is now a real read-only provenance + lifecycle panel (adapted-from vs from-scratch, visibility, created/updated); Year-2 timeline+rollback stays a roadmap note; tab drops v2 badge. TestHistoryProvenance x3 + 2 FE tests. Committed 2b9f9d8 (be) + e703878 (fe).
